premises.text: Customer service is poor across various industries
premises.evidence_span: Customer service sucks. You all know this, you've seen it, on airlines, at hotels, at retail, at restaurants, at Starbucks, wherever.

premises.text: Empowering customers to rate service interactions can improve customer service
premises.evidence_span: allow people to rate the interactions they have, so that by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better.

premises.text: Tello provides a platform for customers to give feedback on service experiences
premises.evidence_span: So today we're announcing our customer service rating system

premises.text: Businesses can use aggregated ratings to improve their service
premises.evidence_span: we will provide a portal, essentially, a dashboard for businesses where they can go in and at a glance see what's going on with their business.

premises.text: Tello can be integrated with other location-based apps for customer service ratings
premises.evidence_span: we see a ton of opportunities and have already started conversations with other location-based apps for integrating this functionality into those apps.

value.text: Customers receive better service through feedback mechanisms
value.evidence_span: by shining a bright light on it, customer service gets better.
